## Run Workflow

Validates the move against the Workflow card, enforces the guard (requires-note / requires-role — actor roles are caller-supplied, since cards have no current user), writes the state, and keeps the linked SLA honest across the pause boundary: entering a waiting state stamps pausedSince + opens a pause interval; leaving pushes every running deadline out by the pause. Refusals name the rule AND the fixing action.

```ts
import RunWorkflowCommand from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/commands/run-workflow-command';

await new RunWorkflowCommand(commandContext).execute(input);
```

### Non-goals

For Ticket subjects the status write belongs to transition-ticket-status; this command is for workflow-as-data records.
